summary: This clinical trial is testing a medical device called Revita DMR Treatment for adults with type 2 diabetes. The study compares the device treatment to a sham procedure, which is a fake procedure used for comparison. The sponsor for this trial is Academisch Medisch Centrum - Universiteit van Amsterdam (AMC-UvA).

facts.sponsor: Academisch Medisch Centrum - Universiteit van Amsterdam (AMC-UvA)
